name: The sealed envelope
tagline: A sealed envelope. Tap it open and read the letter one line at a time.

options.label: Who is it for?
options.hint: Their name, as you would say it

options.label: Your message
options.hint: Leave a blank line between paragraphs

options.label: Photos
options.hint: Up to 6, in the order you want them shown

options.label: A video (optional)
options.hint: Up to 30 MB, about a minute

options.label: A song (optional)
options.hint: Your own song file, up to 15 MB

options.label: Tell me when it is opened
options.hint: We email you the first 2 times someone on another network opens it.

shop.headline: A letter they open themselves
shop.blurb: A sealed envelope. They tap it open and read your words one line at a time.

steps.title: Who is this gift for?
steps.hint: Their name, the way you would say it out loud.

steps.title: Now, say it.
steps.hint: Write it like you are talking to them. Blank line = new paragraph.

steps.title: Add some photos
steps.hint: Your favourites of the two of you. You can skip this.

steps.title: Make it unforgettable
steps.hint: A video message or your song (both optional), and whether we tell you when it is opened.

steps.title: Choose the feel
steps.hint: Tap one. You can change it any time.
